title: Update once. Skip the installer.
summary: Desktop updates now close DOIT AI, install silently, and reopen the updated app without showing the setup wizard again.
highlights: One-click restart from the DOIT update popup
Silent installation for existing Windows users
Automatic relaunch as soon as the update finishes
No repeated installation-location or user-selection screens
The full installer remains available for first-time installs

title: Return to DOIT. Stay in sync.
summary: Workspace sync now resumes automatically after authentication, billing, and other external redirects across web, desktop, and mobile.
highlights: Automatically resumes sync when DOIT becomes active again
Handles browser returns, desktop deep links, and mobile app links
Recovers from suspended network requests without restarting the app
Prevents older sync requests from overwriting fresh workspace data
Stops a failed request from displaying Syncing forever

title: Cancellation emails that finish the job.
summary: Stripe cancellations now wait for the restored session, retry failed owner notifications, and remain recoverable without reopening Stripe.
highlights: Reliable owner emails for paid and trial cancellations
Automatic retries after returning from Stripe
Webhook reconciliation even when the app saved cancellation first
A dedicated retry button without repeating the cancellation
Clear separation between confirmed billing state and email delivery

title: Try the full system in three focused days.

highlights: Three-day introductory trial for eligible Pro subscribers
Three-day introductory trial for eligible MAX subscribers
Matching trial countdowns across web, desktop, Android, and iOS
Existing subscribers keep the trial end date already promised at checkout

title: Made to fit every screen.

highlights: Phone-sized typography instead of desktop text squeezed onto mobile
Stable navigation sizing with separate phone and tablet layouts
Safe spacing around notches, gesture bars, and screen edges
Responsive cards, progress panels, and metadata on narrow phones
Better use of tablet width without stretching content too far
Improved landscape support and shorter-screen sheet positioning

title: Google sign-in lands where it should.
summary: Desktop Google sign-in now returns securely from the browser and completes inside DOIT without showing a false expired-link error.
highlights: Returns Google sign-in from the browser directly to the desktop app
Uses a secure PKCE exchange owned by the device that started sign-in
Prevents one-time OAuth callback codes from being consumed twice
